The '''RD-15A Centurion''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. Green versions of the armor were seen in usage of Mandalorian Medics and Mandalorian Commandos during the [[Raid on Darvannis]].
